hint.zh: 最里面的框里，三个假设都看得见。
hint.en: Inside the innermost box, all three assumptions are visible.

t.zh: 下雨的时候，只要刮风，就地湿；下雨的时候，一定刮风。那么下雨的时候，就地湿：这是在「下雨」这个条件下套用。这句话叫 <part-ref to="lemma:axS"></part-ref>。
t.en: When it rains, if it is windy the ground is wet; when it rains, it is windy. So when it rains, the ground is wet: Apply under the condition “it rains”. This sentence is called <part-ref to="lemma:axS"></part-ref>.
